title: Register for the Science Fair
summary: Sign-up for the Nov 12 Science Fair
details: The Science Fair is Thursday, November 12. Register your child by Wednesday, October 28.

title: Send in a tri-fold poster board
summary: Display board for the Science Fair project
details: Send a tri-fold poster board for your child's Science Fair project by Wednesday, November 4.

title: Pay the $8 pumpkin patch fee
summary: Trip fee for the Hummingbirds' pumpkin farm visit
details: The Hummingbirds visit Arata's Pumpkin Farm on Friday, October 30. Pay the $8 trip fee by Friday, October 23.

title: Send muddy-ready boots
summary: Boots for the Hummingbirds' pumpkin farm trip
details: Send your child in boots that can get muddy for the pumpkin farm trip on Friday, October 30.
